about: The facts this camera's looks established that its coverage ledger's public form carries, the one part of it no public source gives, written by kit/tools/coverage.py --write where the mapper's looks file is (docs/decisions/0023): rows that open an information screen with the kit's address field names, rows that act when opened, rows and values a hand check saw change a record, rows of the maker's Save/Load list seen to change nothing. Each holds true of every camera of the model: never a run, a date, a state seen or a value (docs/decisions/0016).
